Fridge scanned and pantry checked! Quick check-in before tonight's suggestions:

> 🔍 **Did I miss anything?** Any items in the door shelves or closed containers I couldn't see? Is anything nearly finished I shouldn't rely on — like the eggs, butter, or OJ? And that small dark jar — is it soy sauce, vanilla extract, or something else?

---

## 🧊 Full Inventory — Fridge + Pantry

| Source | Ingredients |
|---|---|
| 🥬 Fridge — Leafy & Fresh | Butter lettuce, spinach/chard *(use in 2–3 days!)*, fresh parsley |
| 🥦 Fridge — Vegetables | Broccoli, red cabbage, white cabbage *(use soon!)*, kohlrabi, watermelon radish *(use soon!)*, beetroot, baby carrots |
| 🧀 Fridge — Dairy | Feta (~200g), butter *(running low ~125g!)*, eggs (6–8) |
| 🫙 Fridge — Preserved | Tomato sauce/passata (3 jars), olives/dark fruit, small dark jar |
| 🍋 Fridge — Fresh | Lemons (2–3), orange juice *(partial — use soon!)* |
| 🥫 Pantry | Potatoes, okra, grilled chicken, prawns, Greek yoghurt, milk, onions, garlic, ginger, cumin, rice, soy sauce, butter, carrots |

---

> 🔔 **Heads up!** I notice your fridge contents look very similar to the last few times you've shared a photo — the spinach, watermelon radish, white cabbage, and OJ keep appearing and are getting closer to needing to be used up. Let's make sure tonight's dinner tackles some of those! 🌿

---

## 🍽️ Tonight's Dinner — Family-Tailored Suggestions

Keeping in mind: **your Type 2 diabetes** (low GI), **your wife's vegetarianism**, the **girls' love of chicken & eggs**, and your **Indian & Chinese cuisine preferences**! 🍛🥢

---

### 🍛 1. Indian Saag Chicken with Spiced Potatoes ⭐ Top Pick!
**Uses:** Spinach *(fridge — use now!)*, grilled chicken *(pantry)*, potatoes, onions, garlic, ginger, cumin, tomato sauce, butter
Classic **Saag Chicken** — a silky, spiced spinach curry with tender chicken. Serve alongside small portions of cumin-spiced potatoes. For your wife, make a **Saag Paneer-style** version using crumbled feta in place of paneer — it works beautifully!
- ✅ Low GI — spinach base is excellent for Type 2
- ✅ Wife gets a vegetarian feta/saag version
- ✅ Girls get their beloved chicken!
- ⏱ ~25 mins

---

### 🥢 2. Chinese Prawn & Broccoli Stir-Fry with Egg Fried Cauliflower Rice
**Uses:** Prawns *(pantry)*, broccoli, carrots, white cabbage *(use soon!)*, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, onions, eggs
Stir-fry prawns and veggies in a soy-ginger sauce, served over **egg fried cauliflower rice** (blitz broccoli stems as a low-GI rice swap). Make a double egg portion for the girls on the side.
- ✅ Low GI with cauliflower rice
- ✅ Wife gets an egg & vegetable stir-fry from the same wok
- ✅ Girls get prawns + extra egg fried rice!
- ⏱ ~20 mins

---

### 🥬 3. Indian Spiced Okra & Egg Bhurji Bowl
**Uses:** Okra *(pantry)*, eggs, onions, garlic, ginger, cumin, tomato sauce, spinach, watermelon radish *(fridge — use now!)*, parsley
**Bhindi Masala** (spiced okra) paired with **Egg Bhurji** (Indian scrambled eggs with spices). Serve with fresh butter lettuce and thinly sliced watermelon radish for a crunchy, colourful side.
- ✅ Naturally low GI and high fibre — brilliant for Type 2
- ✅ Fully vegetarian — whole family can share!
- ✅ Girls get their eggs in a fun, spiced bhurji style
- ⏱ ~25 mins

---

### 🌟 My Top Pick Tonight
**Saag Chicken** 🌿🍗 is tonight's winner! It uses up the spinach that's been in your fridge for a few days now, the grilled chicken that's ready to go, and your pantry spices. A quick feta-saag swap for your wife takes just minutes. Serve with a small portion of spiced potatoes — a proper Indian feast for the whole family! 🎉

---

Would you like a **step-by-step recipe** for tonight, or shall we plan the **full week of meals** and finally use up that watermelon radish, cabbage, and OJ? 😊
